fact: The October 2007 evaluation mission found almost no digital records of autos, case files or any other PRM procedure, with IT use rudimentary and mainly restricted to the Central Command, limited in provincial commands and non-existent at district and police station level, and piles of paper serving as case file archives.
title: Support to the Police of the Republic of Mozambique: Project Outcome Evaluation, Phase I, II and III - Final Report
